answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A island delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A sonnet check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A wander penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 6079 identities need 6079 bonds of 14 tokens, 29369 dollars of hardware and 23 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
